Bills.title: Vendor bills
Bills.body:
The payables list: every supplier bill with its open amount, due date and status. Input VAT arises on these bills.

Here you capture a new bill. Paying runs through the same payment allocation used everywhere in the product, so there is only one settlement path.

The list reconciles back to the creditors account in the ledger. Any difference is stated rather than hidden.
